body.message:
Good morning Simone,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to sincerely inform you that, unfortunately, we are unable to provide a one-bedroom apartment in Bayz by Danube due to some issues with the unit, and currently only a studio is available there.

To ensure you still have a comfortable and better experience, we have upgraded and moved your booking to Urban Oasis - Building, located in the same Business Bay area, very close to Bayz by Danube. This is a one-bedroom apartment and is considered an even better option in terms of comfort and quality.

I will share the link with you shortly so you can review the apartment. The unit is ready, and we are also happy to offer you an early check-in at 12:00 PM.

Simone, we truly understand this is a last-minute change, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. We really appreciate your understanding and hope you will enjoy your stay in the new apartment.
